card.name: Scattered punctuation in political texts
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on assorted punctuation, 'of', and digits in general web prose about labour, politics and history.

modes.label: Punctuation in lists
modes.description: Commas or periods inside lists of rights or hardships in policy statements.
modes.example: abolition of forced labour, equality of opportunity and treatment<<,>> and other standards regulating conditions across the entire

modes.label: Word 'of' after a noun
modes.description: The word 'of' after a noun like victims or destruction in historical or political text.

card.plain: It reacts to scattered small words and punctuation in political and historical text, with no clear single theme.
